posts.hook: OpenAI shelved its top model, then sold nearly the same thing for less
posts.caption: openai's devday brought gpt-6.1 sol, claimed near astra level at a fifth of the price, trump released a voluntary ai accord instead of new rules, and anthropic says a chinese open model can build working exploits. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: OpenAI releases GPT-6.1 Sol, claimed near Astra at a fifth of the price
slides.desc: Days after Astra was scrapped, the ==cheaper model== is what ships

slides.title: Trump releases a voluntary AI accord with tech leaders instead of new rules
slides.desc: It asks for external auditors and internal controls, but nothing is enforced

slides.title: Anthropic says GLM-5.3 can build end-to-end exploits with few safeguards
slides.desc: Its refusals were bypassed 64% of the time with ==simple deceptive prompts==

terms.gloss: an ai model from the chinese lab zhipu

slides.title: Appeals court rejects Ross's fair use defense for AI training
slides.desc: Thomson Reuters keeps its win, a first appellate signal on training data

slides.title: Dutch police arrest a man in connection with ShinyHunters
slides.desc: He was arrested Sep 15, days before the group claimed an FBI hack

terms.gloss: a hacking group tied to the ticketmaster and rockstar breaches

slides.title: Anthropic routed 47% of 2025 sales through Amazon and Google
slides.desc: Its IPO filing shows the cloud partners are both channel and dependency

posts.hook: The AI labs signed a pledge in the morning and got a regulator's letter by afternoon
posts.caption: the ftc is reportedly widening its probe of frontier ai labs, cloudflare says more than half of internet traffic wasn't human this year, and google is reportedly testing payments to publishers for ai search. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: FTC is reportedly expanding its probe of Anthropic, OpenAI and other frontier labs
slides.desc: Formal demands for information are planned, an ==enforcement track== the voluntary accord lacks

terms.gloss: the US agency that polices unfair business practices

slides.title: Cloudflare says more than half of Internet traffic wasn't human this year
slides.desc: Requests from AI agents grew 1,700% in a year, and they don't see ads

slides.title: Google reportedly pays about 100 publishers for content feeding AI search
slides.desc: One early participant reportedly earned over $1M, a first sign of pay-per-use

slides.title: Meta's Muse agent is drawing privacy complaints
slides.desc: It can buy things for you, and one report says it sent a YouTuber's address to a stranger

slides.title: Cloudflare plans free quantum-safe TLS certificates
slides.desc: Sites could switch on protection against future quantum attacks with no speed penalty, it says

terms.gloss: the encryption behind the padlock in your browser
